speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Laryngotracheoesophageal Cleft (LTOC) or Tracheoesophageal Fistula (TEF). The combination of recurrent stridor/wheezing, symptoms worsening during feeding, and the absence of fever strongly suggests an abnormal communication between the respiratory and digestive tracts rather than simple laryngomalacia. I recommend an Upper Gastrointestinal Contrast Study (Barium Swallow) to confirm the diagnosis immediately.
